subject: Proration for mid-cycle add-on (Aptura) — invoice & VAT follow-up
messages:
From: Daniel Reyes <daniel.reyes@aptura.ai>

Cc: billing@aptura.ai
Date: Mon, 9 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Adding 4 Dedicated seats mid-billing-cycle — invoice question

Hi Soojin,

We pushed four additional dedicated seats onto our Dedicated plan yesterday to support a new internal integration. Our billing contact (billing@aptura.ai) noticed a separate line item for a partial-month charge and a prorated amount — can you confirm how that was calculated and whether we should expect a credit for the unused portion of the seats we removed last week? Our accounting team needs the VAT treatment (we're based in Ireland) and a PDF certificate if you require it.

Also attaching the PO for the add-on (PO# AP-0789).

Thanks,
Daniel
Senior Platform Engineer, Aptura Systems
Attachment: Aptura-PO-AP-0789.pdf (application/pdf, 42 KB)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Reyes <daniel.reyes@aptura.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 9 Feb 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Adding 4 Dedicated seats mid-billing-cycle — invoice question

Hi Daniel — thanks for the PO and the heads up. Quick answers up front:
- The partial-month charge is a prorated charge for the 4 additional seats from the date they were added through your current billing period end (we bill daily pro rata for seat capacity changes).
- If you had seats removed earlier in the cycle we would usually apply a credit for the unused days; I don't see an automatic credit on file yet. I'll loop in finance to confirm and issue a credit note if applicable.
- For VAT: we need your VAT certificate (if you have one) to validate reverse-charge handling. If you supply it I will route it to our tax team and mark the invoice accordingly.

Naomi (finance) — can you confirm the credit workflow and estimated credit amount if we reconcile the removed seats?
Marissa — FYI for account continuity.

Daniel — if you can send the VAT cert as an attachment to this thread I'll get it processed today.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Naomi / Rishi — forwarding Aptura's VAT cert and PO. Key points: they added +4 seats on 2026-02-08, previously removed -2 seats on 2026-01-23. Please: 
1) Calculate prorated charge for the 4 added seats through their billing period end (billing cycle ends 2026-02-28) and include VAT treatment as reverse-charge (they provided cert).
2) Calculate credit for the two seats removed on 2026-01-23 (unused days in Jan). Apply credit to the current invoice or issue a separate credit note — whichever is standard.
3) Generate an updated invoice PDF and a credit note (if any) and confirm whether we need signatures/DocuSign for the PO match.

I need this processed today if possible; Aptura's AP team is waiting.

Thanks,
Soojin

Soojin / team — ran the numbers. Summary here (rounded to 2 decimals):
- Billing period: 2026-02-01 through 2026-02-28 (28 days)
- Daily rate per Dedicated seat (monthly equivalent): EUR 450.00 / 28 = EUR 16.07/day
- Charge for +4 seats starting 2026-02-08 (21 days remaining including start date): 4 * 16.07 * 21 = EUR 1,350. - posted as prorated add-on on invoice INV-2026-02-APT-0789
- Credit for -2 seats removed on 2026-01-23: Jan cycle had 31 days; unused days from 2026-01-24 through 2026-01-31 = 8 days. Daily rate same as above. Credit = 2 * 16.07 * 8 = EUR 257.12 -> issue credit note CN-2026-02-APT-0789
- Net additional amount due on current invoice = EUR 1,350.00 - EUR 257.12 = EUR 1,092.88 (EUR, reverse-charge applies — VAT 0% on Redwood invoice once VAT cert validated)

I've attached the credit note PDF and updated invoice draft. Please confirm the PO number AP-0789 matches the invoice (it does) and let me know if we should apply the credit to the current invoice or leave it as a separate posted credit. Standard practice is to apply the credit now unless customer requests separate posting.

Attachments: Redwood-credit-note-AP-0789-02.pdf, INV-2026-02-APT-0789-draft.pdf

Naomi
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>

All good — I applied the credit to INV-2026-02-APT-0789 in our billing system and generated the final invoice (INV-2026-02-APT-0789-final.pdf). Reverse-charge VAT applied per the cert; we've added the VAT reference and EORI to the invoice header. Payment link and updated PO reference were included. DocuSign not required for the PO match per finance policy. I've posted the updated invoice to the customer's portal and emailed billing@aptura.ai with a secure PDF link: https://billing.redwood.com/invoices/INV-2026-02-APT-0789-final.pdf

Soojin — please confirm with Aptura and close the loop.

Thanks,
Rishi
